description.zh: 消费金额调整方向 increase:增加,用户消费增加金额 decrease:减少,用户充值减少金额 [必填]
description.en: The adjustment direction for the consumption amount. This parameter is required. Valid values: \`increase\` and \`decrease\`.

description.zh: 调整金额,单位为元,金额必须大于0。
description.en: The adjustment amount, in CNY. The value must be greater than 0.

description.zh: 外部业务主键ID，用于做幂等性校验使用
description.en: The unique ID of the business operation. This ID is used to ensure idempotence.

description.zh: 请求来源，填写系统名称即可
description.en: The source of the request. Specify the system name.

title.zh: 进行用户 Quota 消费抵扣

descriptions.zh: 进行用户 Quota 消费抵扣。
descriptions.en: Adjusts the consumed quota amount for a user.
